DEFENCE OF PAKISTAN RULES, 1965
DEFENCE
OF PAKISTAN RULES, 1965
(Amendment
in Notification No. S. R. O. 127, dated the 9th September 1965)
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 1st October 1965]
S. R. O. 249 (R)/65. In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section 3 of the Imports
and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 (XXXIX of 1950), read with rule 139 of the Defence of Pakistan Rules, the Central Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amend ment shall be made in this
Ministry's Notification No. S. R. O. 127, dated the 9th September 1965,
namely:
In the
aforesaid Notification, in entry 7, in item (i), for
the full-stop at the end a semi-colon shall be substituted and thereafter the
following new item shall be added, namely:
"(j)
biscuits and confectionery".
[File
No. 3 (34)/65-EP.]
